intro: The old skipper died with the chart in his head, and being a suspicious soul he had it pressed into the crew's skin in fragments, so the sea would never take the whole of it at once. Each morning the men rinse off the salt and rub the fresh ink smooth, and by noon the same strange smudge has settled on the inner wrist of every sailor, in the same place it settled yesterday. The bosun blames the salt, but the mate who mixes the ink only frowns and checks the glass. We have learned to leave our wrists alone when the swab comes round, and the ship keeps moving. Nobody speaks of the chart as a whole, least of all the men who can feel it itching under the bandage.
echo: Fletcher Christian took the Bounty. The crew here are considering something similar.
